GST Registration Summary

Source: R/functions.R
gst_registration_summary.Rd

State-wise taxpayer registration counts, optionally filtered by region.

gst_registration_summary(
  region = NULL,
  type = c("normal", "composition", "isd", "casual", "tcs", "tds")
)

Arguments

region

character vector. NULL = all.

type

character vector. Registration types to include: "normal", "composition", "isd", "casual", "tcs", "tds". Default = all.

Value

A data.table.

Examples

gst_registration_summary(region = "South")
